t.zh: 最近邻只会照抄：[0, 4] 放大成 4 像素，新像素不是 0 就是 4。可中间的新像素离两边的距离不一样，照抄丢掉了这个信息。
t.en: Nearest neighbour only copies: [0, 4] enlarged to 4 pixels gives every new pixel 0 or 4. Yet the middle ones sit at different distances from the two sides, and copying throws that away.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：新像素一定要等于某一个旧像素吗？先在格子上手算一行，再接一块电路：输入一行像素和新的宽、高，交出缩放后的图。这一关的图都只有一行；测试和隐藏测试的每个值都对才算对。
t.en: This level asks: must a new pixel equal one of the old ones? First work one row out by hand on the grid, then wire a circuit: given a row of pixels and a new width and height, give the resized image. This level's images are all one row high; it is right when every value in the tests and hidden tests is.

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="linear-interpolation"></wiki-ref>：新像素按到左右两个旧像素的距离加权，离谁近谁的份量大，两份权重加起来是 1。
after.en: This is <wiki-ref to="linear-interpolation"></wiki-ref>: a new pixel weighs its left and right neighbours by distance, the nearer counting more, the two weights adding to 1.

brief.zh: [0, 4] 放大成 4 像素：新像素落在 x = −0.25、0.25、0.75、1.25。按到两边旧像素的距离，写出每个新像素的值；落在两端外面的，取最近的边。
brief.en: [0, 4] enlarged to 4 pixels: the new pixels sit at x = −0.25, 0.25, 0.75 and 1.25. Write each one's value by its distance to the old pixels on either side; one beyond an end takes the nearest edge.

hint.zh: x = 0.25 离 x = 0 有 0.25，离 x = 1 有 0.75。离得近的那一边该占几成？
hint.en: x = 0.25 is 0.25 from x = 0 and 0.75 from x = 1. What share should the nearer side take?

why.zh: 这是照抄最近的旧像素：x = 0.25 和 x = 0.75 落在不同的位置，却拿到一样的值。按距离加权，0.25 处是 0.75 × 0 + 0.25 × 4 = 1。
why.en: That copies the nearest old pixel: x = 0.25 and x = 0.75 sit at different places but get one value each side. Weighted by distance, 0.25 gives 0.75 × 0 + 0.25 × 4 = 1.

brief.zh: 输入一行像素和新的宽、高：交出缩放后的图，每个新像素由左右两个旧像素按距离加权。
brief.en: Given a row of pixels and a new width and height, give the resized image, each new pixel weighted from its left and right old pixels by distance.

hint.zh: 中间那个新像素离左右两个旧像素各有多远？
hint.en: How far is the middle new pixel from each of the two old ones?

hint.zh: 先找出新位置左边那个旧像素，再算新位置离它有多远。
hint.en: First find the old pixel to the left of the new position, then how far the position is from it.

hint.zh: 两端的新位置落在原图之外：取像素可以设成取最近的边。
hint.en: The new positions at the ends fall outside the original: the lookup can be set to read the nearest edge.
